items:
Home Highlights
-Private Resort Style Pool and Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day from October 1 - May 1)
-3 Minute walk to the Beach
-Pool House Game Room with Additional Sleeping
-6 Seater Golf Cart Included
-6 Bikes Included

Set on a generous, private lot in the coveted Eastern Lake area, this exceptional new-construction beach retreat offers refined coastal living just a three-minute walk from the Gulf. Located south of 30A, the home delivers both privacy and effortless access to one of the area’s most desirable stretches of beach.

Designed with entertaining in mind, the open-concept interiors flow seamlessly to an elegant outdoor oasis featuring a private resort-style pool and spa with a wet deck, an ideal setting for sun-soaked afternoons or evening relaxation. (Pool heat available for an additional $70 per day from October 1–May 1.)

A stylish pool house with a game room and additional sleeping accommodations enhances the resort-like experience, while the main residence showcases upscale finishes throughout. The primary suite serves as a private sanctuary with a spa-inspired bath, soaking tub, separate shower, and a custom-designed closet.

With a six-seater golf cart and six bikes included, exploring 30A and nearby favorites is effortless. Perfect for families or discerning groups, this Eastern Lake home offers a polished blend of luxury, comfort, and coastal sophistication.
